_comment: Hand-authored printer profiles for vendors upstream OrcaSlicer does not ship.
printers.json is REGENERATED in full by web/extract_all.py from the OrcaSlicer checkout, so a profile added
there by hand disappears on the next run. This file is the durable half: never generated, merged over the
extracted set at load time by engine/src/settings.js. The two stay separable on purpose — printers.json is
exactly what upstream ships, this is exactly what it does not.
Only values the vendor has PUBLISHED go in. Everything else is left out rather than guessed: an omitted key
falls through to the schema/kernel default, while an invented acceleration would quietly change every time
estimate the profile produces and read as fact. `unpublished` lists what is missing so a vendor conversation
has a concrete agenda, and so nobody mistakes absence for 'not applicable'.
The long-term home for a profile is upstream itself (that is how Cubicon reaches printers.json). This file is
for the interval before that, and for vendors who never get there.

unpublished: machine_max_acceleration_* — the spec sheet gives no acceleration; it drives the time estimate
bed temperature for ABS/ASA/Nylon: the sheet lists them as supported but caps the bed at 80C
notes: CoreXY, 41kg, 715x755x865mm outer. Layer height 0.05-0.4 selectable, 0.2 default.
Materials listed: PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, ASA, Nylon, Carbon PLA, Carbon Nylon.
Auto levelling through four independent Z motors.
The sheet recommends PrusaSlicer — the vendor ships no slicer of its own.
